title: Ectoplasm
description:
Ectoplasm and Spectre Ingots are crafting items required for other parts of the mod. Spectre Ingots are crafted out of ectoplasm, gold and lapis. Ectoplasm is dropped by Spirits that sometimes spawn when a player kills an entity. Spirits can not be harmed by physical attacks (An exception being the Spectre Sword ), they are incorporeal after all. You will have to use magic to kill them (e.g. potions). When killed they drop at least one ectoplasm with a 20% chance of dropping a second one. However they also die by themselves after 20 seconds, not leaving any drops behind. They will float around a bit but should always stay close to the place they spawned. Leaves of the Spectre Tree also occasionally drop Ectoplasm.

By default the chance of a spirit spawning is 1%, however there are 2 things that increase the chance:

- If the Ender Dragon was defeated in this world the chance will increase by 7% (Configurable)

- If the entity died at night under open sky the chance will increase depending on the moon phase (2% on full moon, configurable; no bonus during the day or on new moon)

Therefore in total after defeating the ender dragon & being under a full moon at night the chance of getting a spirit to spawn will be 10%.

The Spirit Spawn Egg spawns a Spirit and is not craftable.
